# T-5: Add stripDataMarkers helper to the directive parser

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose a pure helper that strips paired data-directive markers from already-expanded markdown and throws on any unexpanded data block remaining.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Strip removes opening + closing data marker comment lines.
- Surrounding markdown is byte-equal to the input minus those markers.
- Idempotent.
- Throws on unexpanded data block.

## Implementation Notes
Reuses existing INLINE_DATA_RE / ENDDATA_RE regex shapes.

## Test Strategy
Unit test covering pure-strip, idempotent, and throw-on-unexpanded cases.
